column1: # CHECKPOINT SWEEP: retrain the three bases saving EVERY epoch, so every checkpoint can be
# scored by cell-eval and compared against the one `val_pearson_delta` selects.
# WHY. pipeline.py's own comment on the selection criterion: "This criterion was MEASURED to
# rank checkpoints wrongly on the real panel in the research tree: it picked one arm and put
# the eventual bake-off winner last ... cell-eval v1 takes ~60 min per evaluation, far too slow
# to run every few epochs." Only best/final are kept, so the 29 discarded checkpoints per run
# have never been examined. Independently, validation has misranked FOUR sweeps in this
# C1 = M03's loss, C2 = M06's, C3 = Q02's. Loss terms bit-identical to the bases; the ONLY
# change is save_every_epochs=1, passed as an override.
# ⚠️ 2.13 GB per checkpoint, 30 epochs, 3 runs = ~192 GB. Disk has 3.2 P free.
# ⚠️ A retrain will NOT reproduce the originals bit-for-bit (GPU nondeterminism), so these
# arms' best_metric picks may differ from the existing M03/M06/Q02 checkpoints. The comparison
# is valid because it is WITHIN each new run; the retrained arms are not drop-in replacements.
